title: chore(client): add a timeout argument to fetch
body:
## Summary
Add a timeout parameter to fetch() in src/client.py, defaulting to 30, and pass it to _get(); add tests/test_client.py covering fetch('u') and fetch('u', 5).

## Rationale
Callers need to choose a timeout for slow endpoints instead of always waiting 30 seconds.

## Testing
Validation plan: run tests/test_client.py, which expects ('u', 30) from fetch('u') and ('u', 5) from fetch('u', 5).

## Limitations
Only fetch() is changed; the timeout value is not validated.

files.patch:
diff --git a/src/client.py b/src/client.py
--- a/src/client.py
+++ b/src/client.py
@@ -2,5 +2,5 @@
     return (url, timeout)
 
 
-def fetch(url):
-    return _get(url, 30)
+def fetch(url, timeout=30):
+    return _get(url, timeout)

diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -0,0 +1,6 @@
+from src.client import fetch
+
+
+def test_fetch():
+    assert fetch('u') == ('u', 30)
+    assert fetch('u', 5) == ('u', 5)
